result.description: Cloud communications platform with APIs for SMS/MMS/WhatsApp messaging, voice, verification, video, contact center (Flex) and more.
result.auth_detail: HTTP Basic auth: API key SID + secret (preferred; Main/Standard/Restricted keys) or Account SID + Auth Token (legacy). No OAuth2 for REST APIs; Access Tokens exist only for client-side SDKs.
result.access_detail: Free signup, no credit card. Trial lasts 30 days, can message only verified numbers (up to 5), and has restricted message bodies. Upgrade to a paid account lifts the limits. Credentials work immediately.
result.api_notes: Each product has its own REST API (Messaging, Voice, Verify, Conversations, Video, Flex, Sync, TaskRouter, Lookup, SendGrid Email, etc.). Twilio says its MCP covers 1,800+ endpoints across 30+ products. Official SDKs in many languages.

evidence.quote: API keys are the preferred way to authenticate with Twilio's REST APIs.
Use your API key SID as the username and your API key secret as the password.
You can sign up for a Twilio free trial account without a credit card.
Each account can verify up to 5 recipients.
each product corresponds to an API.
Twilio APIs give you flexibility, global reach, and reliable deliverability to connect with customers anywhere.
No Account SID, API key, or other credential is required or accepted.
